land.text: Cliopatria's Molossian shape: the Molossis of Dodona and the Pogoni heartland round Ioannina

predecessors.note: The Molossians were a member of the Epirote League and the core of the Aeacid kingdom (kingdom-of-epirus, 370-167); this dossier is the 170-168 span in which Cliopatria and the Third Macedonian War page treat them as a party of their own.

land.text: the Molossis after the defeat: the Molossians page has 150,000 Epirotes, mostly Molossians, enslaved by decision of the Roman Senate

successors.note: The kingdom-of-epirus dossier, from another page, dates the fall of Molossia to 167; this page dates nothing in 167.

capitals.name: Passaron (near Ioannina)
capitals.note: Approximate: the Molossians page names Passaron as the capital Pyrrhus left for Ambracia in 295 and Dodona as the religious capital from c. 290 but gives no seat for 170; the coordinates are the gazetteer's Ioannina, a stand-in.

correction.text: the shape as drawn, for 170-168 only: the infobox's Molossians 'from 170 BC' on Perseus's side and the page's 'Molossians in Epirus, on the west coast of Greece, went over to the Macedonians'; the Roman reprisal ends the Molossian state in 168 and Cliopatria's 165 is three years late

keyframe_review.note: 170-165, 4.7 k km2, 17 cells at 20.15-20.9 E, 39.5-40.0 N: the Molossis, with Dodona (39.55 N) and Pogoni (40.0 N) inside. Neither page gives an area, so no infobox ratio; the Molossians page has the heartland (Pogoni) and Dodona 'in the Molossis', which the shape covers.

region.text: Cliopatria's Molossian shape: the Molossis of Dodona and the Pogoni heartland round Ioannina

ledger.note: 170: the Molossians go over to Perseus against Rome. The infobox lists 'Molossians (from 170 BC)' with the Macedonian side and the narrative says 'Molossians in Epirus, on the west coast of Greece, went over to the Macedonians'; the Molossians page adds that Kephalos 'sided with Perseus against the Romans' in about 170. The Molossian state itself is older (c. 370) and is one with the Epirote League's core.

region.text: Cliopatria's Molossian shape: the Molossis of Dodona and the Pogoni heartland round Ioannina

ledger.note: 168: the Molossians are crushed. 'The Molossians sided with the Macedonians against Rome in the Third Macedonian War (171-168 BC) and were defeated'; 150,000 Epirotes, mostly Molossians, were enslaved by decision of the Roman Senate (undated on the page, which speaks of the devastation after 168). The Third Macedonian War page adds that troops were sent to seventy cities.

ledger.note: 168: the Molossian state ends with the Roman victory of the war it joined; the page does not describe a Molossian state ending in 167, and the kingdom-of-epirus dossier dates the fall of Molossia to 167 from another page.

wars.name: Third Macedonian War

zones.text: Cliopatria's Molossian shape: the Molossis of Dodona and the Pogoni heartland round Ioannina

wars.outcome: Perseus lost at Pydna in 168; the Molossians, on his side from 170, were defeated and, on the Molossians page, 150,000 Epirotes were enslaved; the Chaonians and Thesprotians fought for Rome (Appius Claudius's force included Thesprotian and Chaonian contingents).
wars.note: The war page gives 168 for Pydna with no month and no year for the Epirote reprisal. The Molossians page calls Charops a Chaonian Roman ally whom Scullard's older theory has pushing for the Molossians' destruction.

certainty.note: No page gives a Molossian frontier.

notes: Cliopatria's 'Molossians' (-170..-165, one 4.7 k km2 shape) is a sliver of the Epirote core drawn for the years the Molossians fought Rome. The kingdom-of-epirus dossier (another group) already covers the Molossian state from c. 370 to 167 as the Aeacid kingdom and Epirote League, so the two overlap on the Molossis in 170-167; the cleaner drawing is one Epirus dossier with a hatched or contested Molossis in 170-168. Dates: start 170 (infobox 'from 170 BC'; Cliopatria 170); end 168 (the page: defeated in the 171-168 war; the 150,000 enslaved and the seventy cities are undated on both pages, while kingdom-of-epirus has 167 from the 'Epirus (ancient state)' page, not opened here). Cliopatria's 165 is three years late. Not on the pages opened: any Molossian frontier or area, the 232/233 league's internal structure, Charops's and Kephalos's roles beyond the one line, the Roman sack year. Counterparts: kingdom-of-epirus (predecessor), roman-republic (the loss), antigonid-dynasty (ally; its dossier carries a vassal_start/vassal_end for 'molossians' in 170-168). Gazetteer names needed: Passaron and Dodona (places), Molossis (region).
